description: This source file defines the AppShell widget in Flutter, which provides the main user interface scaffold for the app. It includes bottom navigation with four tabs (Home, Topics, Chat, Docs), a floating action button that navigates to a Scan screen, and maintains tab state using IndexedStack.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: Main widget class for the application scaffold containing bottom navigation, app bar, and floating action button.

classes.name: _AppShellState
classes.description: State class managing the current tab index and corresponding UI updates.

methods.name: _onNavTap
methods.description: Handles navigation tab tap events, updating the current index.

methods.name: _onFabTap
methods.description: Handles floating action button tap to navigate to the Scan screen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the scaffold widget tree, including AppBar, IndexedStack for tab views, FAB, and bottom navigation.
